Episode data covers episodes 1–387 (original series through the start of Thousand-Year Blood War) against chapters 1–586. Volumes 1–54 (chapters 1–479) are what the original anime adapted; volumes 55+ are Thousand-Year Blood War manga, only partly covered by episode data here.

Some chapter references (negative numbers, decimals like "0.8") are bonus/prequel chapters — mainly the Turn Back the Pendulum arc — not part of the main chapter count.

Arc boundaries are derived from chapter ranges (Comic Book Treasury's arc summary), cross-checked against the volume data above. One correction was needed: that source's arc summary says the Arrancar arc ends at volume 46, but the chapter math (183–423) actually lands at volume 48 — used here.

Sources: episode–chapter correspondence and volume/arc chapter ranges compiled by ListFist.com and Comic Book Treasury.
